name: kitchen-sink
description: Every step kind
inputs:
  goal:
    required: true
    prompt: What's the goal?
    multiline: true
  label:
    required: false
    default: x
    remember: true
on_findings: loop
steps:
  - id: plan
    kind: agent
    runner: claude
    model: opus
    mode: interactive
    writes: false
    prompt: Plan {{ inputs.goal }} for {{ run.name }}
    output: plan.md
    allow_paths:
      - docs/**
    allow_commits: false
    effort: high
    harvest_timeout_ms: 5000
  - id: lint
    inputs:
      - plan
    kind: command
    run: npm run lint -- "{{ inputs.label }}"
    cwd: packages
    env:
      CI: "1"
      LABEL: "{{ inputs.label }}"
    timeout_ms: 60000
    expect_exit:
      - 0
      - 1
    output: lint.log
  - kind: loop
    id: cycle
    steps:
      - id: execute
        inputs:
          - plan
          - review
        kind: agent
        runner: copilot
        mode: headless
        writes: true
        prompt: Iteration {{ loop.iteration }} of {{ loop.max_iterations }}
        output: report.md
      - id: review
        verdict: true
        kind: command
        run: test -f report.md
        expect_exit:
          - 0
        output: review.log
    until: review
    max_iterations: 2
    on_exhausted: interactive
  - kind: stages
    id: stages
    items: plans/*.md
    steps:
      - id: implement
        inputs:
          - stage
        verdict: true
        kind: command
        run: echo "{{ stage.id }} {{ stage.index }}/{{ stage.total }}"
        output: impl.log
      - id: gate
        kind: approval
        title: Stage {{ stage.title }}
        instructions: Accept this stage?
        default: continue
    max_retries: 1
  - id: sign-off
    enabled: true
    kind: manual
    title: Sign off
    instructions: Read the review notes.
    capture: review
    show_diff: true
    output: notes.md

name: cycle
inputs:
  feature:
    required: true
    prompt: What are we building?
  branch:
    required: false
    prompt: Target branch
    default: main
    remember: true
steps:
  - id: plan
    inputs:
      - attachments
    kind: agent
    runner: claude
    model: opus
    mode: interactive
    writes: false
    prompt: |
      We are planning: {{ inputs.feature }}
      Work with me on a plan. Do not modify any files.
    output: plan.md
  - kind: loop
    id: fix-cycle
    steps:
      - kind: loop
        id: test-fix
        steps:
          - id: execute
            inputs:
              - plan
              - tests
              - review
              - sign-off
            kind: agent
            runner: claude
            model: sonnet
            mode: headless
            writes: true
            prompt: >
              Implement the attached plan. This is attempt {{ loop.iteration }}
              of

              {{ loop.max_iterations }}. Report what you changed.
            output: execute-report.md
          - id: tests
            verdict: true
            kind: command
            run: npm test
            timeout_ms: 600000
            output: tests.log
        until: tests
        max_iterations: 3
      - id: review
        inputs:
          - plan
          - execute
          - tests
          - sign-off
        verdict: true
        kind: agent
        runner: claude
        model: haiku
        mode: headless
        writes: false
        prompt: Review the diff against the plan and the test output.
        output: findings.md
      - id: sign-off
        inputs:
          - review
        verdict: true
        kind: approval
        title: Ship {{ inputs.feature }} to {{ inputs.branch }}?
        instructions: |
          Check the diff and the findings. Approve to ship, or send it back
          with comments — on the whole change set, or on individual files.
        capture: review
        show_diff: true
        output: feedback.md
    until: sign-off
    max_iterations: 3
    on_exhausted: report
  - id: release-note
    kind: manual
    title: Release note
    instructions: One line for the changelog.
    capture: note
    output: release-note.md

name: spec-driven
description: A functional spec and a technical spec, each grilled, then a

  feature:

      first.

    mode: interactive

name: staged-feature-development
description: Cut a large feature into stages, then build, review, accept and
  commit one stage at a time.
inputs:
  feature:
    required: true
    prompt: What are we building?
  base:
    required: false
    prompt: Branch to start from
    default: main
    multiline: false
  test_command:
    required: false
    prompt: Test command (leave blank to skip tests)
    default: npm test
    remember: true
    multiline: false
steps:
  - id: sync-base
    kind: command
    run: git checkout "{{ inputs.base }}" && git pull --ff-only
    output: sync-base.log
  - id: branch
    kind: command
    run: git checkout -b "feature/{{ run.slug }}"
    output: branch.log
  - id: plan
    inputs:
      - attachments
    kind: agent
    runner: claude
    model: opus
    mode: interactive
    writes: true
    prompt: >
      We are planning: {{ inputs.feature }}.

      Before exploring, ask me whether there are files or docs you should read
      first.

      Work with me on a plan, then cut the work into stages. Order them so each
      builds on

      the earlier ones, which the workflow will already have committed by the
      time it is

      built, and keep each small enough to review in one sitting.

      Write one file per stage into {{ run.dir }}/plans/, named NN-slug.md, and
      nowhere

      else. The build turns every .md file in that folder into a stage, so put
      nothing

      else there. Each stage file follows this template:

      # <Stage title>

      ## Goal

      What this stage achieves, and why.

      ## Scope

      What to build or change.

      ## Out of scope

      What this stage must leave alone, including work that belongs to a later
      stage.

      ## Files

      The files it touches.

      ## Acceptance criteria

      Checkable statements a reviewer can walk through one by one.

      ## Verify

      The exact command(s) that exercise this stage, because the workflow's test
      command

      may not cover it.

      Change nothing in the repository. The artifact you write is the agreed
      plan as it

      now stands, not a transcript of our conversation.

      Before you tell me the plan is done, list {{ run.dir }}/plans/ and confirm
      that every

      stage file is there and that nothing was written elsewhere.
    output: plan.md
    allow_paths:
      - "{{ run.dir }}/**"
  - kind: stages
    id: build
    items: "{{ run.dir }}/plans/*.md"
    steps:
      - kind: loop
        id: do-review
        steps:
          - kind: loop
            id: test-fix
            steps:
              - id: execute
                inputs:
                  - stage
                  - tests
                  - review
                kind: agent
                runner: claude
                model: sonnet
                mode: headless
                writes: true
                prompt: >
                  Implement stage {{ stage.index }} of {{ stage.total }}: {{
                  stage.title }}.

                  Earlier stages are implemented and already committed by the
                  workflow —

                  read the tree or `git log` if you need them. Implement only
                  this stage,

                  and leave it uncommitted: committing is the workflow's job,
                  not yours. A

                  human reads the working tree at the gate below, and the
                  workflow commits

                  it once they have accepted. If a tests log marked VERDICT:
                  FAIL is

                  attached, fix every failure first; if review findings are
                  attached,

                  address every point.

                  Implement everything the stage asks. If something can't or
                  shouldn't be

                  done, don't drop it silently: say so in the report.

                  Your report, the artifact, has these sections under exactly
                  these headings:

                  ## Changed

                  The files you changed or added, one line each.

                  ## Verified

                  The exact commands you ran and their result. Run the tests
                  relevant to

                  what you changed, not only the workflow's test command.

                  ## Not done / not verified

                  Anything you did not do or check, with the reason.

                  ## Deviations from the plan

                  Where you departed from the stage, with the reason.

                  ## Findings addressed

                  Only when a tests log, review findings or rejection feedback
                  were

                  attached: one line per point, and how you addressed it.
                output: execute-report.md
              - id: tests
                verdict: true
                kind: command
                run: eval "{{ inputs.test_command }}"
                timeout_ms: 1800000
                output: tests.log
            until: tests
            max_iterations: 3
          - id: review
            inputs:
              - stage
              - execute
              - tests
            verdict: true
            kind: agent
            runner: claude
            model: opus
            mode: headless
            writes: false
            prompt: >
              Review the uncommitted working-tree diff (`git diff` plus
              untracked

              files) against this stage only. Walk the stage requirement by

              requirement and state for each whether it is met. If the
              implementer's

              report says a previous rejection's feedback was addressed, check
              that every

              point it names was actually addressed.

              Check every claim in the execute report against the diff. A false
              claim

              is blocking. Also blocking:

              - HEAD moved, or the executor committed (check `git log`)

              - changes outside the stage's scope

              - an empty diff when the stage requires changes

              - a review or rejection point that was not addressed

              If the attached tests log does not exercise the changed code, say
              so and

              run the relevant tests yourself, with read-only commands only.

              An improvement outside the stage is non-blocking at most.
            output: review.md
        until: review
        max_iterations: 10
      - id: accept
        inputs:
          - stage
          - review
        kind: approval
        title: "Stage {{ stage.index }}/{{ stage.total }}: {{ stage.title }}"
        instructions: Accept this stage before the next one starts.
        capture: review
        show_diff: true
        output: accept.md
      - id: stage-changes
        kind: command
        run: git add -A -- . ":![.]whiphand/runs/*"
        output: stage-changes.log
      - id: commit-message
        inputs:
          - stage
          - review
          - accept
        kind: agent
        runner: claude
        model: haiku
        mode: headless
        writes: false
        prompt: >
          Write the commit message for the change staged on this branch.

          Its source of truth is `git diff --cached`, plus the attached plan or
          stage

          file, review and feedback for why the change was made. Do not copy or

          paraphrase an existing commit message, such as one from `git log`.

          The subject is the first line: imperative mood, at most 72 characters,
          no

          trailing period. Then one blank line, then a body of one to three
          lines, each

          wrapped at 72 characters, in plain sentences with no bullets. The body
          says

          what changed and why.

          Trailers such as `Co-Authored-By` are allowed. If you add any, put
          them after

          the body, separated from it by one blank line.

          The file holds the message and nothing else: no preamble, no code
          fences, no

          review.

          If the index is empty, write a one-line subject saying so instead of
          asking.
        output: commit-message.md
      - id: commit
        inputs:
          - commit-message
        kind: command
        run: git diff --cached --quiet && echo "nothing to commit for this stage" || git
          commit -F "$WHIPHAND_ARTIFACT_COMMIT_MESSAGE"
        output: commit.log
    max_retries: 2
  - id: push
    kind: command
    run: git push -u origin "feature/{{ run.slug }}"
    output: push.log

    until: review
